channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kristaps Porzingis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kristaps Porzingis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Durant asked.

“It's the Americans who had an influence on them. It's cool that some of them won MVP awards, but who did they look up to. Jokic, Porzingis, Shai, they all wore Iverson's jerseys and imitated his crossovers. They try to play like us and they succeeded in their own way.”

Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Kristaps Porzingis, Aug 29, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
“Both guys are very talented. I think everything in the NBA is circumstantial. I think players need the right set of circumstances to thrive. And the trade made sense because these were not the right circumstances for JK. And you can see right away that Kristaps has a very clear role on this team, something we’ve needed for years. And we’re looking forward to getting him out there with Steph. And so in the end, hopefully it’s a trade that works for both guys and both teams.”

Steve Kerr on Kristaps Porzingis, Mar 20, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
95.7 The Game: Steve Kerr on Kristaps Porzingis' availability for the Warriors tomorrow night against the Lakers:

“We'll list him as questionable. The hope is definitely that he'll be able to play tomorrow.”

Steve Kerr on Kristaps Porzingis, Feb 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on beating Warriors’ Al Horford and Kristaps Porzingis tonight:

“Those guys helped me win a championship in 2024, so no better way than to respect them than giving them the belt tonight.”

Jaylen Brown on Al Horford, Kristaps Porzingis, Feb 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Wyc Grousbeck, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
“Like, think about this: when Wyc (Grousbeck) and the new ownership came in there, what did they do? Trades, new coach, everything. That’s sports. I don’t care what type of team you got; whenever you’ve got new ownership, there’s always going to be changes. That’s what I learned in this business. I expected that.“Then as far as them getting rid of Jrue and Porzingis, you know they’re trying to cut costs and things of that nature — which is understandable. They’re business people, too.”

Paul Pierce on Wyc Grousbeck, Kristaps Porzingis, Sep 11, 2025. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Kristaps Porzingis, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Pierce said to Heavy on Celtics.

“Whether he’s hurt or not, I think they would have had to still make these decisions.“But I do think it made it easier to make them. Like, let’s say Jayson’s healthy and they won the championship. Then if you break it up, it’s like, what are we doing? So I think it made it easier to make those moves with Jrue and Porzingis and all that.”

Paul Pierce on Kristaps Porzingis, Jayson Tatum, Sep 11, 2025. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Georges Niang on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Georges Niang:

“I then get traded for Kristaps Porziņģis—which, you know how tough Boston fans are. They don’t give a [ __ ] if I’m from Boston or not. They're like, 'You just took our unicorn and replaced it with a minivan.' They're like, 'Get the [ __ ] out of here!' You know what I’m saying? Like, they want superstars.”

Georges Niang on Kristaps Porzingis, Jul 22, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on Kristaps Porzingis:

“KP's been a large part of our success. Our recent success... In the playoffs, he wasn't feeling his best, but we appreciate him getting out there. KP is a tough guy. He has a great mentality.”

Jaylen Brown on Kristaps Porzingis, May 16, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, Luke Kornet
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Joe Mazzulla on going with Luke Kornet over Kristaps Porzingis:

“He couldn't breathe. He was available if absolutely necessary ... that was a decision between me and him.”

Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, Luke Kornet, May 14, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Al Horford on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Horford on KP' struggles:

“I haven't said anything to him, but Kristaps is a great competitor. I know he'll respond and he'll be ready...it's a little different (of a matchup).But we just have to make sure we play at our pace. I feel like we got bogged down a little last game.”

Al Horford on Kristaps Porzingis, Apr 27, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis’ cut:

“I like watching him bleed on the court. I think it's important.”

Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, Apr 24, 2025. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Gary Harris on Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Derrick White
item.description:
veteran guard Gary Harris told the Sentinel after practice Tuesday.

“Understanding [we need to] take out some of those 3s from Derrick White and [Payton] Pritchard. They hit some bigs 3s. “I know we did a good job on [Jayson] Tatum, [Jaylen] Brown and [Kristaps] Porzingis for the most part but [we need to] continue to just fly around, scramble and take away those 3s because those 3s were hurting us, especially after the turnovers in transition.”

Gary Harris on Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Derrick White, Apr 22, 2025. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“I'm really encouraged by the health of our team. Kristaps had the surgery that was well-documented. Seems to be recovering well.”

Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis, Sep 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis:

“We’re very, very pleased with where he is and maybe a little surprised.”

Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis, Sep 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Porzingis:

“Surgery went great. I think the way that it impacts us is just making sure that we have the right amount of bodies for the start of the season. Obviously, he'll be back at some point in the season.”

Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
This is also something from Brad Stevens on Russillo:

“Kristaps Porzingis, after his surgery, we don't know exactly when he'll be back, but he'll probably miss at least the very start of the season. So that'll be a great opportunity for us to do things different and have to find different solutions.”

Brad Stevens on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jason Kidd on how the Mavericks will attack Kristaps Porzingis, who is returning from a left leg issue:

“We'll see how he moves, but I think that healthy or not healthy . . . we are going to still check to see how he moves. So nothing changes there.”

Jason Kidd on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Kristaps Porzingis:

“Miss him a lot. Top-3 player on our team. … Comedic relief. It’s been great playing with him, and we wish he was out there with us.”

Jrue Holiday on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Kidd:

“We knew that (Porzingis) would play and he played well. We gotta make it tougher on him ... he can shoot it from half court with range ... on the other end, we gotta make him work.”

Jason Kidd on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jay King:Luka Doncic on Kristaps Porzingis:

“I don’t really know why it didn’t work out. We were both young.”

Luka Doncic on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Brian Robb:Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis:

“We still have to see how he responds each day to what he's doing.”

Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Chandler Parsons, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
“Because people don't know. I talked to Chandler Parsons probably twice in my life. I don't know how he would know that. But me and KP (Porzingis) have a good relationship. I don't know why people say otherwise.”

Luka Doncic on Chandler Parsons, Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 4, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Mazzulla on Porziņģis finally getting a chance to play beyond the first round:

“One of the great things about him is he’s been through so many things that he has a poise and temperament about him.”

Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, Jun 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Brian Robb:Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis:

“He went through a couple drills today in practice. We're confident in where he's at.”

Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, May 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jay King:Jrue Holiday on Kristaps Porzingis:

“We can’t wait for him to get back and be a part of this on the court.”

Jrue Holiday on Kristaps Porzingis, May 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis:

“Seemed to be walking a little bit better. A guy like him, he knows exactly what he has to do … So I just saw him walk a little bit better … I know he's doing everything he can to get back as fast as he can.”

Joe Mazzulla on Kristaps Porzingis, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Derrick White on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Jay King:Derrick White on Kristaps Porzingis’ absence:

“People have stepped up all year long and I don’t expect anything different now.”

Derrick White on Kristaps Porzingis, May 1, 2024. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Al Horford on Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Al Horford on Porzingis’ injury:

“Worried. Just concerned. Anytime that any of your guys go back, especially him, the way he was walking, definitely concerning for me.”

Al Horford on Kristaps Porzingis, Apr 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“Yeah, it is. I think I'm better than I was 2 years ago, [Jaylen Brown] is better, [Kristaps Porzingis] makes all the difference in the world, obviously Jrue Holiday.”

Jayson Tatum on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown, Feb 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Michael Malone on Kristaps Porzingis, Holiday:

“Length, shot blocking and a tough matchup ... he can roll with force and handle the ball.”

Michael Malone on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Jan 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.
